title: 2mi->Broadway | Pool | Speakeasy Historic 3BR Loft
description:
History Meets Luxury in This One-of-a-Kind Nashville Stay!

This top-floor condo, set in a late Civil-War-era tobacco warehouse, blends vintage and industrial style. With soaring ceilings, original cedar beams, and graffiti-covered brick walls, it offers a luxe experience with a nod to the building's rich history. The perfect mix of old-world charm and modern comfort—truly a unique Nashville stay! 

1.6mi to Broadway
2.2mi to Bridgestone Arena
2.6mi to Nissan Stadium

Follow us on IG! @peakhost

The space
Bring Your Crew—This Spot is Ready for Fun!

This vibrant, spacious condo is your group’s ultimate home base for a fun getaway! Comfortably sleeping 10, it boasts 3 bedrooms with super-cozy mattresses, 2 full bathrooms, a fully stocked kitchen, and a chill living room. Plus, there’s a washer and dryer to keep everything fresh for your adventures!

Shared Building Perks:
✨ Top-Floor Balcony: Just steps down the hall, this furnished hangout spot is perfect for morning coffee or sunset vibes.

💦 Plunge Pool: Cool off in the shared patio’s dipping pool—perfect for a refreshing soak (just don’t expect Olympic laps!).

🍹 Grills & Self-Serve Bar: Fire up the grills or mix your favorite drink at the communal bar area by the pool. Fun and relaxation are just downstairs!

Prime Location: Set in an industrial-meets-residential area, this condo puts you just 2 miles from the downtown action and close to the city’s trendiest neighborhoods. From mouthwatering eats and craft cocktails to parks, shops, and coffee spots, it’s all within reach!

Guest access
Convenience & Accessibility? We’ve Got You Covered! 🚗✨

Free Parking: Enjoy hassle-free parking inside the gated property of The 1865—secure and super convenient!

Easy Access: Both the building and condo feature keypad entry for a seamless check-in experience. Plus, an elevator whisks you up to the top floor with ease.

Other things to note
A Quick Note About Trains 🚂:
While you won’t hear road noise at the condo, there is a train track next to the building. It’s not a high-speed line, but you may hear some noise as trains pass by. To keep things cozy and quiet, we’ve got you covered with white noise machines and earplugs for a peaceful night’s sleep!
